caption:
Seven small swaps for your evenings this week.

Most of it is boring on purpose. Number 2 is the big one. Alcohol might knock you out, but it breaks up your sleep in the second half of the night, and it shows up as puffy eyes and dull skin within days. Our advice is simple: leave it out.

Number 7 is the one nobody wants to hear. Going to bed at the same time every night does more for how you look and feel than any face wash.

Save this for the next 14 days, and send it to a mate who needs it.
